profile.headline: Senior Front-End Web Developer
profile.summary:
Award-winning, customer-centric creative manager; project and program leader acknowledged for consistent excellence in project management, Agile/Scrum methodology, client liaison and advocacy, professional partnership and relationship building, graphic design, marketing/branding, team management, risk assessment and planning.

Builds trust quickly; thinks analytically; solves problems. Verifiable track record delivering superior outcomes and fostering business success for enterprise clients and in roles spanning Technology/Software, Telecom, Transportation, Healthcare, Beverage, and Corporate Marketing sectors; Microsoft, Alaska Airlines, T-Mobile, and others.

Builds a strong culture and engenders mutually-beneficial outcomes by removing roadblocks to progress, improving efficiencies, easing resistance to change, and mentoring team members. Believes today's Agile must enable a flat, wide organizational structure supporting creative, innovative ideation and collaboration.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Web Developer
positions.description: SEO and data driven website design to drive quality conversions for the hospitality industry. Creative, custom, clean coded responsive design with minimal plug-ins to be solid and stable. Site Auditing, Google Analytics, Looker Studio Reporting. Plus, I make the site look good. Also build custom graphics for inhouse and social media use that support the property and brands.

positions.description: Skills: Google Analytics · Web Development · Web Design · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Website auditing

positions.title: Freelance Graphic Designer and Project Management Consultant
positions.description: Skills: Adobe Photoshop · Client Relations · Account Management · Adobe Illustrator · Client Liaison

positions.title: Vice President of Homeowners Association
positions.description:
In addition to serving as Board Member and VP over a full three-year term, provided leadership as de facto program and project manager. Shepherded team through discovery, R&D, scope identification, legal review, and vendor and contractor management—and through delivery and community acceptance processes on multiple projects and capital initiatives.    
•	Established a de facto PMO commensurate with EEF/OPA compliance to govern association’s project management directives, as well as a cogent violation enforcement process.   
•	Major initiative during tenure was an overarching push to provide more valuable and meaningful information to homeowners, delivered in a more digestible and usable form. At the epicenter of this effort was a complete redesign of the association’s website for improved UX/UI; overhauled site content and SEO; project-managed migration to new platform and web hosting company. Developed/managed new website SOPs/Best Practices. 
•	Collective efforts significantly reduced budget costs for reallocation into reserves (89%) to Association members.

positions.title: Parks and Recreation Board Member
positions.description:
Provided liaison with City Council communicating Parks & Recreation strategic roadmap and plans for individual projects, including development of new parks, and improvements to existing parks and related programs. 
•	Ran design and community engagement processes for creation and development of a new 1.25 acre city park in Mill Creek, Washington. Held numerous town hall meetings and events to solicit feedback resulting in community acceptance of the project. Personally developed the design ultimately chosen for the new park. Provided framework via Adobe Illustrator; liaison with contractors; park was completed October 2019. 
•	Sponsored design of phase 2 enhancement program for existing five-acre park. Completed gap analysis to identify pressing needs. Advised on changes to address underserved segments (e.g., plethora of programs for teens, adults, and seniors; a dearth of options for younger kids). Overhauled facilities use fees and procedures, park maintenance policies, governance for city-held events, and capital improvement planning. 
•	Recognized with “Proclamation of Honor” for excellence in service by Mill Creek Mayor, City Manager, and City Council members.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Promoted to leadership role leading cross-functional teams; driving project management engagements for the company’s tier I accounts, including T-Mobile, Philips Healthcare, Alaska Airlines, and others, as well as secondary support for 24 tier II accounts. Responsible for revenue forecasting and management of CAPEX budgets. 

Managed cross-functional team of 15 designers to deliver integrated marketing programs consisting of presentation content, multimedia materials, banners, graphics, signage, and booth design for large-scale events. Supported investor and white paper presentations, and direct channel sales efforts.  
Within an Agile environment, meticulously developed and managed project scope, budgets, scheduling, QA, risk management, launch/delivery and lessons-learned activities to achieve profitability and maximum ROI.   

Responsible for brand stewardship as acting Creative Director to assigned accounts, providing artistic and creative direction aligned with clients’ established aesthetics and messaging, and overall quality standards. 

Provided thought leadership and strategic direction aligned with company’s long-term objective to diversify spread of accounts, and minimize risk. (At one point, Microsoft represented 80% of company’s total annual revenues). Within two years, reduced to 60%; within three years reached goal 50%.

Maintained ability to provide continued graphic design support
positions.insights: Skills: Account Management · Team Leadership · Adobe Creative Suite · Project Management · Creative Problem Solving

positions.title: Contract Graphic Designer
positions.description: Freelance contract design work for various retail, service, and technology firms. Project deliverables included print, website, packaging, and logo design.

positions.title: Redhook Brewery
positions.description:
Designer of diverse marketing collateral, including menus, promotional merchandise, and cross-portal advertisements. Products were marketed for online and brick and mortar retail. Provided new product concepts and design aesthetics to marketing group. 
•	Supported key company events by providing design concepts and collateral materials, and handling vendor selection and relationship coordination.
